name: viral-video-teardown-remake
description: Paste the link or bring the file, break a short video that worked into its hook, beats, and call to action, then rebuild that structure around your own subject as a shot list, beat frames, and narration — delivered as one vertical clip animated from your opening frame, or, when the reference cuts too fast or runs too long for a single take, as segmented sources with captions and a timecoded edit list.
